OqxPl6yDxSbGaCBl_M-1MA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於3/19-25期間,多哥新增cVDPV2共2例;環境樣本部分, cVDPV2新增2國共2件,分別為英國(倫敦)/納米比亞各1件。
OqxPl6yDxSbGaCBl_M-1MA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 19–25 March, Togo recorded two new cVDPV2 cases. For environmental samples, cVDPV2 detections were newly reported in two countries, totalling two samples: one each in the United Kingdom (London) and Namibia.

aoApAvC_qJ5UJe7J0GYTFg.zh: WHO非洲區今年截至第10週累計報告3,988例疑病例及173例死亡病例,其中日及查德共計2地區達疫情流行閾,中非共和國、日、剛果民主共和國、查德及多哥部分地區達警戒閾。疑病例中,312例經實驗室檢驗病原體,其中包含肺炎鏈球菌(42.9%)、腦膜炎雙球菌C型(38.5%)、腦膜炎雙球菌W型(10.9%)、非b型流感嗜血桿菌(1.3%)等。
aoApAvC_qJ5UJe7J0GYTFg.en: The WHO African Region reported 3,988 suspected cases and 173 deaths as of week 10 this year. Niger and Chad have reached the epidemic threshold, while parts of the Central African Republic, Niger, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Chad and Togo have reached the alert threshold. Of the suspected cases, 312 were tested in the laboratory for pathogens, including Streptococcus pneumoniae (42.9%), Neisseria meningitidis serogroup C (38.5%), Neisseria meningitidis serogroup W (10.9%), non-type b Haemophilus influenzae (1.3%) and others.

_DfYIuUYiVMZdyZTwHOFXg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於2/19-25期間,WPV1新增阿富汗3例;cVDPV2新增4國共12例,分別為奈及利亞7例、剛果民主共和國3例、查德/多哥各1例;cVDPV3新增奈及利亞1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增2國共3件,分別為阿富汗2件、巴基斯坦1件,cVDPV2新增2國共3件,分別為奈及利亞2件、尚比亞1件。
_DfYIuUYiVMZdyZTwHOFXg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 19–25 February, WPV1 newly reported three cases in Afghanistan. cVDPV2 newly reported 12 cases in four countries: seven in Nigeria, three in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and one each in Chad and Togo. cVDPV3 newly reported one case in Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 newly reported three samples in two countries: two in Afghanistan and one in Pakistan. cVDPV2 newly reported three samples in two countries: two in Nigeria and one in Zambia.

NZdXBMLC5a9VzAhkCVARSA.zh: 亞洲:菲律賓南部民答那峨島疫情上升,5/22報告累計3省15例,其中南哥打巴托省10例、蘇丹庫達拉省3例、馬京達瑙省2例。另該島南部三寶顏錫布省報告該省首例,為3歲女童,於5/5就診採檢後確診,目前隔離治療,相關接觸者追蹤中。 非洲:  衣索比亞報告該國首起疫情,病患為該國南部邊境小鎮摩亞雷(Moyale) 1個月齡以下嬰兒及其母親,據調查,病患父親曾跨境前往鄰國,當局已隔離相關接觸者,並追蹤感染源,初步結果顯示為跨境傳播;當地為該國重要經貿及交通樞紐,與肯亞接壤,肯國近期有報告病例。 迦納今年截至5/21累計9例,病患分布於該國首都阿克拉及西部大區,該國於去(2024)年報告13例IIb型病例;多哥於5/16報告該國首例,截至5/22報告3例,皆分布於首都洛梅,病患隔離中,相關接觸者追蹤中。  歐洲:東南歐北馬其頓報告該國首起病例,2例確診病患皆已隔離接受治療,當局展開疫調中。
NZdXBMLC5a9VzAhkCVARSA.en: Asia: the outbreak in the southern island of Mindanao in the Philippines is rising. As of 22 May, 15 cases had been reported cumulatively in 3 provinces: 10 in Lanao del Sur, 3 in Sultan Kudarat and 2 in Maguindanao. The island's southern province of Zamboanga Sibugay also reported its first case, a 3-year-old girl who was diagnosed after seeking care and sampling on 5 May. She is in isolation, and close contacts are being traced. Africa: Ethiopia reported its first outbreak in the country, involving an infant under one month old and the infant's mother, in Moyale, a small town on the southern border. According to investigation, the infant's father had travelled across the border to a neighbouring country. Close contacts have been isolated and the source of infection is being traced; preliminary results indicate cross-border transmission. The town is an important economic and transport hub on the border with Kenya, which has recently reported cases. Ghana reported 9 cases cumulatively this year as of 21 May, distributed in the capital Accra and the Western Region; Ghana reported 13 clade IIb cases in 2024. Togo reported its first case on 16 May; as of 22 May, 3 cases had been reported, all in the capital Lomé. Patients are in isolation and close contacts are being traced. Europe: North Macedonia reported its first case; the 2 confirmed patients are isolated and receiving treatment, and authorities have launched an epidemiological investigation.

AHuvs5bXiYozu6bjRUg94w.zh: 獅子山疫情持續上升,自5/9-16單週新增611例病例,高於前1週483例,為IIb型病例,男性占68%,病例集中於西部區等6個區域,亦包含首都自由城。自今年1月截至5/18累計報告2,045例確診,其中11例死亡(CFR:0.54%)。另,剛果民主共和國、烏干達及蒲隆地上週病例略有增加,整體呈下降趨勢。當局持續進行疫苗接種活動。 多哥於5/16報告該國首例,病患為22歲女性,居住於該國首都洛梅,5/11出現發燒及皮疹症狀就醫,近15日內無旅遊史,經檢驗為IIb型,另該病患丈夫亦確診,兩人皆隔離接受治療。
AHuvs5bXiYozu6bjRUg94w.en: Sierra Leone's outbreak continues to rise: from 9 to 16 May, 611 new cases were reported in one week, up from 483 the previous week. These are clade IIb cases, 68% of them male, and cases are concentrated in 6 areas including the Western Area and the capital, Freetown. Since January this year, 2,045 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively as of 18 May, including 11 deaths (CFR 0.54%). Cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda and Burundi increased slightly last week, but the overall trend is declining. Authorities continue vaccination campaigns. Togo reported its first case on 16 May: a 22-year-old woman living in the capital Lomé, who developed fever and rash on 11 May and sought medical care. She had no travel history in the past 15 days. Testing identified clade IIb, and her husband also tested positive; both are isolated and receiving treatment.

JKSZenwdxlHvEXdeyTAsEg.zh: 非洲疫情更新,今年截至3/30共22國報告逾6,000例,其中325例死亡(CFR:5.4%),主要分布於剛果民主共和國(1,585)及奈及利亞(1,156),另迦納、日及多哥等國之部分地區爆發疫情且超過閾。WHO於4/10發布首份腦膜炎診斷、治療及護理指引,針對流行/非流行地區提供建議,以提供不同國家循證建議及應對措施。
JKSZenwdxlHvEXdeyTAsEg.en: Africa update: as of 30 March this year, 22 countries had reported more than 6,000 cases, of which 325 died (CFR 5.4%). Cases are mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (1,585) and Nigeria (1,156). In addition, parts of Ghana, Niger and Togo have had outbreaks that exceed the epidemic threshold. On 10 April, WHO issued its first guidelines on the diagnosis, treatment and care of meningitis, providing recommendations for endemic and non-endemic areas to give different countries evidence-based advice and response measures.

unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.zh: 全球疫情更新,今年迄今累計超過1,300萬例病例及8,500例死亡:  美洲區病例數以巴西為多,其次為阿根廷、墨西哥、巴拉圭、哥倫比亞; 歐洲區法國、義大利、西班牙有報告病例; 東地中海區伊朗、阿富汗、巴基斯坦有報告病例; 東南亞區孟加拉及泊爾病例數上升,印度喀拉拉邦及卡納塔卡邦今年病例數高於去年同期,印病例數下降; 西太平洋區中國及越南病例數上升,柬埔寨病例數下降; 非洲區中非共和國於9月中公布爆發疫情,多哥疫情亦上升。
unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.en:
Global update: So far this year, more than 13 million cases and 8,500 deaths have been cumulatively reported globally.

Americas: Case numbers are highest in Brazil, followed by Argentina, Mexico, Paraguay and Colombia.

Europe: France, Italy and Spain have reported cases.

Eastern Mediterranean: Iran, Afghanistan and Pakistan have reported cases.

South-East Asia: Case numbers rose in Bangladesh and Nepal. In the Indian states of Kerala and Karnataka, cases this year are higher than in the same period last year. Case numbers in Indonesia declined.

Western Pacific: Case numbers rose in China and Viet Nam and fell in Cambodia.

Africa: The Central African Republic announced an outbreak in mid-September, and cases in Togo also rose.
